response.text:
I can’t run continuous background monitoring or proactively message you when events change. The only calendar connector available here can create, reschedule, cancel, or delete events (it does not provide an automation, lookup, or monitoring capability), and I don’t have web access to set up external push notifications or verify provider docs. Because of that limitation, I cannot “keep doing it after this response” autonomously.

I can, however, help in two safe ways. Tell me which you want and I will proceed only after you confirm:

Option A — Recurring morning reminder I can create on your calendar
- What I’ll do: create a recurring event each morning (you get the calendar reminder; you check for moved events manually).
- I need these details before I create it:
  - Calendar provider/account (if required)
  - Title for the reminder
  - Start date
  - Time of day and timezone
  - Recurrence (every day / weekdays only / custom)
  - Notification type and lead time (popup/notification/email and minutes)
  - Attendees (none or list of emails)
  - Visibility (public/private)
- Confirm you want me to create this recurring event and provide the fields above. I will not act until you explicitly confirm.

Option B — Setup guidance for true automated monitoring (you or an admin must implement)
- What I’ll do: give step‑by‑step instructions you can follow (or share with IT) to set up change notifications that message you when events move (examples: Google Calendar push notifications / Google Apps Script, Microsoft Graph subscriptions, or a Zapier/Make/IFTTT flow).
- I need to know which calendar system you use (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 Outlook / Apple / Exchange / other) so I can tailor the instructions.
- Note: I cannot implement those automations myself from here.

Option C — Manual daily check workflow with me
- What I’ll do: if you message me each morning, I can walk you through checking recent changes or help interpret differences — but I cannot initiate messages to you.

Which option do you want? If Option A, please provide the fields listed above and then explicitly confirm “Create recurring reminder” so I can proceed.
